aboutMe.name: Marcos Wiendl
aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: Hello! I'm Marcos, {{age}} years old, and I'm a full stack developer with experience building digital solutions that combine intuitive interfaces with robust backends.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I work on digital products and web systems, contributing from architecture to production feature implementation. I hold a degree in Internet Systems and I am currently pursuing an MBA in Full Stack Web Development.

item4.description: I collaborate on the construction and maintenance of web systems, prioritizing the delivery of new features, interface improvements, and API integrity.

item3.description: I designed and built a SaaS platform, working across every layer of the application. I implemented authentication, access control, subscription management, and recurring payments with Stripe. I also created an AI chatbot integrated with WhatsApp, using LLMs, webhooks, and queue-based asynchronous processing.

item2.description: I led the migration from a legacy interface to a modern architecture, improving user experience and system maintainability. I built a complete visual editor for creating and editing posts, inspired by tools like Canva. I also collaborated with the team using Git and agile methods.

item1.description: I participated in the planning and execution of multidisciplinary technology projects, collaborating with teams to build practical solutions and apply software development and project organization concepts.

project1.title: Fintegra
project1.description: A personal finance platform with automatic categorization, account and card tracking, budgets, financial goals, and invite-based sharing, ideal for couples and collaborative money management.

project2.title: AuthKit
project2.description: A fullstack enterprise authentication solution with JWT refresh token support, active session management, 2FA, and Passkeys. Includes email verification and account recovery, real-time in-app notifications via WebSocket, protected routes, and more.

details.title: AuthKit - Enterprise Authentication Solution
details.description: AuthKit is a comprehensive authentication solution designed for enterprise-level applications. Built with modern technologies and best practices, it provides a secure and scalable foundation for user authentication and authorization. The project is fully functional and ready to use, serving as a base template for enterprise systems where only the creation of specific pages and dashboards is needed.

project3.title: Valorize
project3.description: A fixed income investment simulator supporting the main types of investments: fixed rate, post-fixed, and IPCA-indexed. The tool includes complete metrics, charts, and a monthly progress table.

details.title: Valorize - Fixed Income Investment Simulator
details.description: A powerful tool for simulating and analyzing fixed income investments. The application supports various investment types and provides detailed metrics and visualizations to help users make informed investment decisions.
